title: The Counterfeit Note Transaction
description:
📝 Witness Deposition:
Banker says: 'Merchant passed the fake bill.'
Merchant says: 'Jeweler passed the fake bill.'
Jeweler says: 'Merchant is innocent.'
Detective note: The person who passed the bill is lying; innocent suspects tell the truth.
question: Who passed the counterfeit bill?
hints: Test Merchant as guilty: Merchant lies ('Jeweler passed it' is False).

If Merchant is guilty, Jeweler is innocent (Jeweler says 'Merchant is innocent'? Wait: if Merchant passed it, Jeweler's statement 'Merchant is innocent' is false! So Jeweler lied? No, test Banker=truth, Merchant=guilty).
Banker says Merchant passed it (Truth). Merchant says Jeweler passed it (Liar). Merchant passed the bill.
solution: Banker says Merchant passed it (Truth). Merchant says Jeweler passed it (Liar). Merchant is the culprit who passed the counterfeit bill.
